subject: Post-discovery: proposed 30m demo windows for Hightower AI
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wong <emily.wong@hightower.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@hightower.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + two demo windows (30m)

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion on where Hightower is trying to reduce inference spend and get predictable latency for batch and interactive workloads. Quick recap (short):
- Primary goal: replace current in-house serving to reduce tail latency and driver costs across our tenant services.
- Must-haves: VPC deployment, per-route latency SLOs, and clear quantization guidance for our PyTorch models.
- Nice-to-have: token-level cost dashboards and automatic fallback routing between capacity tiers.

Next step: 30-minute product intro + brief infra Q&A with your engineering lead. To keep this tight, can you pick one of these two windows? I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Option A — Tue, Jun 16, 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B — Wed, Jun 17, 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, suggest two times that suit your engineering lead and I’ll adapt. I’ve attached the short discovery notes and a mutual-action outline so we can align agenda items.

Att: redwood-discovery-notes-20260611.pdf (PDF)
Att: mutual-action-outline.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks—
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

--
Redwood Inference
Production-first inference for teams

We prefer to have our infra lead, Samir, on the call as well; looping him in below (Samir will follow up with calendar availability). For immediate confirmation, Option B on Wed Jun 17 14:00 PT looks better for Tom, but Samir is on UTC+1 and may prefer early morning PT.

Two alternative slots from our side if Option B conflicts with Samir:
- Thu, Jun 18, 08:00–08:30 PT (works for Samir)
- Fri, Jun 19, 11:30–12:00 PT

We can do the 30m agenda you suggested: quick product tour (15m) + infra Q&A (15m). Please include Marissa and David if you think there’s anything we should prep.
